mentions.name: The Trace Journal
mentions.description: A small iOS journaling app that pairs a song with each journal entry, letting users capture the connection between music and memory.
mentions.problem: Music is tied to memory in a way nothing else is, and there was no dedicated place to capture that pairing with journal entries.
